nodes.content: You felt confused in the thick smoke, but the sound of water jets as the firefighters broke through the door woke you up, and you were eventually helped out of the fire scene.

nodes.content: You were choked by the thick smoke and felt dizzy. You subconsciously wanted to hide in the elevator, but the high temperature and heat wave pushed you to the ground, and your consciousness gradually blurred.

metadata.image_prompt: 人物惊恐地用湿毛巾捂住口鼻，身体紧缩在楼梯间转角处，剧烈地咳嗽，泪水在眼眶里打转。四周是翻滚的浓烟，把原本昏暗的楼梯间塞得满满当当，几乎什么也看不清。向下的楼梯被熊熊烈火完全吞没，火舌凶猛地向上舔舐，发出低沉的咆哮声，热浪扑面而来，让人窒息。画面采用中景镜头，吉卜力风格温馨怀旧，即便在危急时刻，光影和色彩也带有柔和的情感，强调人物在灾难面前的渺小与无助。人物形象参考输入的第一张，背景参考第二张（如果有的话）。

nodes.content: You choked on the thick smoke and coughed violently. After realizing that the exhaust fan was operating incorrectly, you quickly turned it off, but the visibility in the room dropped sharply and breathing became difficult. You fumbled to find the faucet, soaked your T-shirt and covered your mouth and nose, but the high temperature had made the door panels hot, and thick smoke kept pouring in from the gaps. You were forced to retreat to the window in search of life. You tried to open the window and call for help, but the high temperature and thick smoke made you dizzy. In your panic, you knocked over the flowerpot on the window sill. The firefighters downstairs noticed the movement and started to lay out life-saving air mattresses.

nodes.content: You fell downwards with the broken pipe and were lucky enough to be blocked by the air conditioner outside the window on the fifth floor, but the violent impact made you lose consciousness instantly. When you regained consciousness, you found yourself lying on the outdoor unit of the air conditioner on the fifth floor. The broken pipe smashed the window on the fourth floor below. Flames were spurting out from the window, completely blocking your downward escape route. You tried to climb from the outdoor unit of the air conditioner to the fifth-floor window, but the scorching air waves and thick smoke forced you back, and you could only cling to the outer wall and wait for rescue.

nodes.content: Just as you tied the sheets to the railing, flames suddenly burst out from the balcony on the fourth floor below, and the heat and smoke instantly engulfed your escape route. You were choked by the thick smoke and coughed violently. The protective effect of the wet towel in your hand dropped sharply, and your consciousness began to blur.
